headlines.text: Rewind to 2024, when it was title-change night for the AEW TBS Title as Mercedes Mone vs. Emi Sakura battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.57 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. On a special Title Tuesday Dynamite, Mon? retained both the TBS and NJPW Strong Women's Titles over Sakura, the veteran she's credited with shaping her early career.

On a Friday in 2021, back when The Lucha Brothers vs. The Acclaimed clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.75. It was the 30th time the AEW World Tag Team Titles had been on the line, a significant milestone for the title. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

Back on this day in 2021, Ricky Starks vs. Brian Cage fought tooth and nail for the FTW Title in a Philadelphia Street Fight match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.58. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: On a Tuesday in 2024, back when Castagnoli & PAC announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.61.
On a Friday in 2021, back when it was the first-ever encounter between CM Punk and Daniel Garcia, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 7.75 ? a match that delivered.
2024 brought us this moment: Hologram vs. Komander met for the very first time, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.06 ? a good, competitive contest.
